title: Discount relation, base and type rules (DIRE/DIBE/DITP)
summary: Drill-down of "Relation, base and type rules": the decision table applied per discount position. Mapped from field guide inputs/dsp-price-calculation.html (sha256:d260ad4216e3); every node is tagged confirmed / design-only / conflicting / code-only against code. Conceptual stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

sources.note: Lines 55-141: DIRE 0 normal, 1 best vs previous (walks back over DIRE 1), 2 override previous line discounts if non-zero, 3 override + stop, 4 stop after if non-zero.

Lines 143-220: internal discounts skipped; agreement/KIT/promotional not included (TODO); DIBE 1/2 (order) skipped, 4 line amount, 6 same base, 7 net after previous; amount before percent; comment: only SGGB 22/SGGC 2 equivalent, no unit conversion.
Lines 1-105: DiscountCategory (1 line, 3 order total), DiscountType (1 %, 2 amount), DiscountBase (1,2,4,6,7), DiscountRelation (0-4) with M3 semantics in comments.

Price Discount Calculation: OGDIPO by OCUSMA.DISY (<= 8 DIPO), allocated discount number (Optimera/Flisekompaniet position 4 for agreement prices), OGDMTX 10 template field sets (PC11..PC91, PC01 = 10) with PREX, LIMT <= requested quantity, SGGB 22/32 + SGGC + SGGU scale limit, DITP/DIBE/DIRE calculation, DDSU presentation (per line vs order total).

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256.
The field guide is a secondary summary (draw.io figures were unreadable to its author); Confluence pages and code are the cited evidence.
